10136|b4b53bc1.name: Chemist Fuely
10136|b4b53bc1.text:
My brother and I have dedicated ourselves to Sylvanas. She is our beacon of light when times were darkest. We sacrifice ourselves day in and day out to ensure our kind overcome the destiny that's chosen us.

We will not remain weak. We will take that which is owed to us. We will return tenfold, the pain that was done to us. And we shall do so with smiles on our faces.

248201|b9df183f.name: Pawani
248201|b9df183f.text: Greetings, friend! I have ample supply of leather and hides, and I know a few techniques I might be willing to share. Interested in doing business?

272526|bf500b92.name: Glix Xizzix
272526|bf500b92.text:
Yes, I am the renowned trader who magnanimously fed the uh, starving... children...? ...of the Undercity during the recent war with the Scourge. Yes, I am the visionary businessgob and logistical genius who single-handedly armed the resistance and allowed our Dark Lady to found her nation of smelly corpses... um, I mean, "Forsaken."

Yep, I'm him. Glix Xizzix. I'd be happy to sign an autograph. For a small fee, of course.

What am I doing here running a barbershop, you ask? Well I got one word for you, bub--diversification. You've got to keep your revenue streams diversified!

3391|8f749700.name: Gazlowe
3391|8f749700.text: Thrall paid me and my boys well for helping out with the construction of Orgrimmar, so I decided to set up a port here. We do most of our business through Booty Bay and Baron Revilgaz.

3419|dabc0513.name: Apothecary Zamah
3419|dabc0513.text: For our people to survive, we must study the ways of nature and learn its secrets.

3453|48c11c0f.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
3453|48c11c0f.text: Something I can help you with, $N? There's a shipment I've got to see to otherwise.

4606|8fca8484.name: Aelthalyste
4606|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

1486-progress.name: Nalpak
1486-progress.text: I am very interested in examining the hides from the deviate creatures who have infested these caves. Have you had any luck in collecting some, $c?
1486-progress.title: Deviate Hides

3369-progress.name: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem
3369-progress.text: May I help you with something?
3369-progress.title: In Nightmares

3921-progress.name: Wenikee Boltbucket
3921-progress.text: I'm very busy with my work, $c.  Unless you have something for me, it'd be best if you moved along...
3921-progress.title: Wenikee Boltbucket

5041-progress.name: Thork
5041-progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
5041-progress.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

7833-progress.name: Vehena
7833-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Darkspear Trolls for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7833-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

844-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-progress.text: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
844-progress.title: Plainstrider Menace

845-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-progress.text: How many zhevra have you slain?
845-progress.title: The Zhevra

848-progress.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-progress.text: Do you have the spores, $N?  There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
848-progress.title: Fungal Spores

853-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
853-progress.text: You have something from Apothecary Helbrim?
853-progress.title: Apothecary Zamah

865-accept.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
865-accept.text:
The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands.  And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns!  If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks."  I could sell them for a fortune!!!

And you can help me.  Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws.  They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.
865-accept.title: Raptor Horns

866-progress.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
866-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Did you get those root samples?
866-progress.title: Root Samples

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-progress.text: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
890-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

891-progress.name: Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun
891-progress.text: My fleet is in peril with Captain Fairmount and her damned cannoneers blasting away from Northwatch Hold. I want her soldiers to pay as well. Fill my hand with medals from their dead and I will know that vengeance has been given to my fallen privateers.
891-progress.title: The Guns of Northwatch

892-progress.name: Gazlowe
892-progress.text: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
892-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

900-progress.name: Control Console
900-progress.text: Blinking lights on the control console indicate that the main control valves have not been closed off.
900-progress.title: Samophlange

901-progress.name: Control Console
901-progress.text: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
901-progress.title: Samophlange

902-progress.name: Sputtervalve
902-progress.text: Oh, you're back, $N! Do you have the samophlange?
902-progress.title: Samophlange

903-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-progress.text: How goes your hunt, $N?  Have you found the prowlers?
903-progress.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

92401-complete.name: Tabitha Heartweaver
92401-complete.text:
What I asked of you was not fair, nor would it have been unjust for you to simply walk away. Thank you stranger. I am unable to repay you in kind but I hope one of these is acceptable.

I hope our paths cross again without such sorrow.
92401-complete.title: A Frightened Request

92421-complete.name: Morbin Lightbane
92421-complete.text:
Let those who fall from the Banshee Queen's grace meet our justice!

With these parts, our brothers and sisters have hope to see another day. You do Captain Bandarion proud.
92421-complete.title: Light's Justice

92421-progress.name: Morbin Lightbane
92421-progress.text: What remains of the invading scourge? Have you managed to find suitable replacement parts?
92421-progress.title: Light's Justice

92422-complete.name: Deathguard Kristof
92422-complete.text:
While I have no doubt something of his kind will be replaced, we can only hope their ranks thin in the meantime.

Thank you $N.
92422-complete.title: The Wrath of Rath'mael

92706-accept.name: Unknown
92706-accept.text:
Calling all anglers!

A giant shark has been circling the waters near the shipping dock, attacking sailors and small boats. Dockworkers have given it the nickname "Bruuz". A hefty reward will be given to whoever brings me its fin!

-- Gazlowe
92706-accept.title: WANTED: Bruuz

92706-complete.name: Gazlowe
92706-complete.text:
Finally, somebody killed that thing! Do you know how hard it is to get a crew in the water when everyone in town's crying "Shark!"all the time?

I might just put that monster's fin into a soup for dinner tonight, just to have the last laugh.
92706-complete.title: WANTED: Bruuz

92706-progress.name: Gazlowe
92706-progress.text: What can I do for ya, $r?
92706-progress.title: WANTED: Bruuz

95216-complete.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-complete.text:
You killed it??

Hmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. You do not wish to be an enemy of the Royal Apothecary Society.

Get out of my sight!
95216-complete.title: The New Plague

95216-progress.name: Theodore Griffs
95216-progress.text:
Any fool can tell you the most potent transmission method will always be through the blood.

I must see this strain for myself!
95216-progress.title: The New Plague

959-accept.name: Crane Operator Bigglefuzz
959-accept.text:
Oops!

Had a little mishap, as you can see! The morning cargo shipment from Booty Bay was huge. Huge I say! Never seen so many crates. Well, I was trying to expedite things so I started unloading a bit more than I could handle. That's when everything came tumbling down.

Before I knew what was going on, I saw that menace, Mad Magglish, go running off with a bottle of 99-year-old port. Chased him all the way to Wailing Caverns. No way I was going in there.

Maybe you're brave enough to find him?
959-accept.title: Trouble at the Docks

962-progress.name: Apothecary Zamah
962-progress.text: I am eager to see if you can gather enough Serpentbloom from the Wailing Caverns. I've sent many to do my bidding but none have returned.
962-progress.title: Serpentbloom

97246-complete.name: Borstan
97246-complete.text:
Of course. Migi's parents and I have an arrangement to give Migi a bagged lunch every day, but I can only ensure the boy gets his food if he actually comes in to pick it up.

Sometimes, he doesn't pick up his meal multiple times a week, and I wonder where he gets the energy to stay out and play.
97246-complete.title: Meal Appeal

97249-complete.name: Migi
97249-complete.text:
Borstan's Meats? Is that for one of us?

Oh!

Wow... this smells really good! Yummy.

Thanks for bringing me my lunch. I can tell what Borstan is going to be serving daily when my friends and I walk the road to Grommash Hold, by the smells alone. This tastes like my favorite, the sweetglaze! But it's different. I like the strong flavored crumbs.

If it's going to be this tasty every day, I think we need to stop our game to take our lunch together!
97249-complete.title: Favorite Food

97249-progress.name: Migi
97249-progress.text: I think we can win this one...
97249-progress.title: Favorite Food

97288-accept.name: Unknown
97288-accept.text:
<As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.

Someone in the Undercity would know more about this unique abomination.>
97288-accept.title: Unending Torment

99048-complete.name: Heglan Shadeeye
99048-complete.text:
Heglan's body lies cold within the wreckage of the hut.

Whatever killed her doesn't seem to be human. There may be signs of what happened nearby.
99048-complete.title: A Missing Hand

99049-accept.name: Heglan Shadeeye
99049-accept.text:
The nearby area is destroyed with obvious signs of a skirmish. Whatever ambushed Heglan didn't make it out unscathed. There's probably signs nearby of what happened.

Orgnil will probably want to see any evidence left by the attackers.
99049-accept.title: Threat from Below

99049-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99049-complete.text:
This banner and blade piece belong to the naga! They must have come down the coast from the north.

We cannot let them establish a foothold here. The pressure from both directions would be too much for Razor Hill.
99049-complete.title: Threat from Below

99051-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99051-accept.text:
It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here.

Find where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.
99051-accept.title: Threat from Below

99051-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99051-complete.text: Hopefully that sends them packing back to the north. I'll have some grunts keep an eye out for any stragglers or funny business.
99051-complete.title: Threat from Below

99051-progress.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99051-progress.text: Hopefully those snake scum aren't giving you trouble?
99051-progress.title: Threat from Below

99052-accept.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99052-accept.text:
One of my scouts has reported a sea giant followed those naga down here. Not sure if they brought him intentionally or what, but he's dangerous in any case.

It's a young one, but it could still rip an orc in half in a heartbeat if they were caught off guard. I need him gone. But I'd suggest you find some help to deal with it.
99052-accept.title: Threat from Below

99052-complete.name: Orgnil Soulscar
99052-complete.text:
Ha! I could hear his body fall from here!

Be proud of your kill today, not many can claim they survived a fight with a sea giant.
99052-complete.title: Threat from Below

99156-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-complete.text:
You are a testament to the cunning and coordination that all Forsaken possess--something the mindless Scourge will never have.

Please accept this as thanks for your efforts, as promised.
99156-complete.title: Rear Guard Patrol

99156-progress.name: Deathguard Linnea
99156-progress.text: Have you dealt with our little problem?
99156-progress.title: Rear Guard Patrol
